summary.short: Classifies medical image analyzers, including computer-assisted detection (CADe) devices for mammography, ultrasound, radiograph lung nodule and dental caries detection, as Class II prescription devices under special controls. Sets design verification, validation and labeling requirements for these devices; the text states no effective date.
summary.long: 21 CFR § 892.2070 describes medical image analyzers, including CADe devices for mammography breast cancer, ultrasound breast lesions, radiograph lung nodules and radiograph dental caries, as prescription devices that mark or direct clinicians' attention to portions of previously acquired radiology images that may reveal abnormalities. The device uses pattern recognition and data analysis, is not intended to replace review by a qualified radiologist, and is not intended for triage or to recommend diagnosis. Paragraph (b) classifies the device as Class II (special controls). Design verification and validation must include a description of the algorithms, pre-specified performance testing and results showing reader performance improvement with diagnostic accuracy measures, and software documentation including cybersecurity. Labeling must describe the patient population, reading protocol, intended user and training, inputs and outputs, compatible imaging hardware, warnings and limitations including failure situations, operating instructions and a summary of performance testing. The text contains no penalty, effective-date or enforcement provisions.
